by: council minutes fork of integrator-9d788fb (proposed; the integrator appends at the merge)
title: A council's minutes PDF in InfoCouncil's standard template, read deterministically from its text layer

landmarks: a usable text layer (support.docread.pages.read_from is not pixels)
its text names attendance (present, apologies, in attendance) and a motion (moved, seconded, resolved, resolution, carried, recommendation)
at least one line RESOLUTION (COMMITTEE or COUNCIL before it, the council's number after it, optional) followed within four lines by a Moved: and a Seconded: line (minutes.standard_resolutions)
an attendance label (PRESENT, IN ATTENDANCE, APOLOGIES, ABSENT, ...) in its first 400 lines

ocr: a PDF with no usable text layer waits for the page reader; a mixed PDF's thin pages are named unread

reading.skips: minutes.sections: a public-excluded part (an item or banner that excludes the public, to the readmission or the end; an item whose heading names public-excluded minutes, to the next item) and a public forum or deputation item are never read, counted only

notes: Attendance from the labels (one person an entry; the public, the media and a body's name are never an attendee); apologies from the apologies item's resolution where no label lists them; declarations: a sentence that names a member and declares an interest or a conflict; resolutions: item, number, mover, seconder, text as moved, outcome line, votes where a division is recorded. A resolution's text carries the flag text_names_address (ruling 102).
applies_to: minutes PDFs landed by registers/council_minutes, from 2 November 2026
process: Skip the public-excluded parts and the public forum items.
gates: Every landed minutes PDF has a ledger line.
No attendee shaped like an address or a contact.
on_fail: the ledger names the state; nothing of the document is published

by: council minutes fork of integrator-9d788fb (proposed; the integrator appends at the merge)
title: A council's minutes PDF in any shape but the standard template, with a text layer, read by the text reader

landmarks: a usable text layer (support.docread.pages.read_from is not pixels)
its text names attendance (present, apologies, in attendance) and a motion (moved, seconded, resolved, resolution, carried, recommendation)
not the standard template (minutes.standard_resolutions is 0, or no attendance label in its first 400 lines)

ocr: a PDF with no usable text layer waits for the page reader; a mixed PDF's thin pages are named unread
prompt: registers.council_minutes.model_read.PROMPT (its hash in the reading's settings): attendance (present, in attendance, apology, absent; never a member of the public), declarations of interest made at the meeting, every resolution with item, number, mover, seconder, text as printed, outcome and votes

reading.skips: minutes.sections, before the text reader sees the text

notes: The text reader never sees a public-excluded part or a public forum item. Whatever it answers, an attendee shaped like an address, a phone number or an email, or named as the public, is dropped. Stored by hash and piece, replayed by the load (ruling 50).
applies_to: minutes PDFs landed by registers/council_minutes, from 2 November 2026
process: Skip the public-excluded parts and the public forum items.
Read each piece with the text reader once; store it.
The load replays the stored pieces.
gates: Every piece stored before the document is published; a piece with no usable answer is named.
on_fail: the ledger names the state (waiting: text reader, or set aside)

by: council minutes scans fork of integrator-9d788fb (proposed; the integrator appends at the merge)
title: A council's minutes PDF with no text layer: a scan, recognised by its shape, every page through the page reader, then read as a text layer is

recognise.by: shape, measured without reading; never a phrase (a scan has no text for a phrase to match)
landmarks: no usable text layer: support.docread.pages.read_from is pixels (every page under 80 characters, or the document under 200)
at least half its pages carry an image at least half the page wide (minutes.picture_pages: pdfinfo and pdfimages -list)
a minutes PDF a council listing names (registers/council_minutes capture, state landed)
not: a text layer (read_from text or mixed): council-minutes-standard or council-minutes-text
a PDF with no text layer and no page image: set aside, not read

signals.old_estate: its 370 InfoCouncil documents (incoming_news.documents, 2 November 2026): 357 text, 12 mixed, 1 low quality, none a scan

ocr: every page through the page reader (profile page-reader, glm-ocr, 200 dpi pinned), the text layer of a scan never used; stored by hash and page under this profile; qv4-council-minutes-pages, in the page reader night window (ruling 129)

reading.tidy: minutes.from_pages: HTML and markdown marks off; a numbered heading mostly in capitals, or one naming a public forum or a public-excluded part in any case, put back as n  TITLE
reading.then: recognised again from the page texts: council-minutes-standard read deterministically, else council-minutes-text through the text reader (settings name the page reader as the text source)
reading.skips: minutes.sections, before either reader: a public-excluded part and a public forum item never read, counted only

notes: The ledger line says read_from pixels; rows cite read_from pixels. A scan with a page unread waits (waiting: page reader) and names its unread pages.
applies_to: minutes PDFs landed by registers/council_minutes, from 2 November 2026
process: Queue one page-reader piece per scan (qv4-council-minutes-pages, night window).
Skip the public-excluded parts and the public forum items.
Read as the standard template or through the text reader.
gates: Every page stored before the document is read; a page missing keeps it waiting.
on_fail: the ledger names the state (waiting: page reader, or set aside: no text layer and no page image)
